correctness.rationale: PASS: On the actual RESULT.md (af9614c1), checked Zak conventions for unit translations, q-fold modulation and unnormalized g_w. The Fourier-side geometric series gives the quoted rational-hyperbolic Zak kernel. Each fiber is increasing in cos(2pi x); the finite q-sum in omega has its minimum at 1/(2q) and maximum at 0. Hence sharp A_q=(pi/w)^2(R_q-q)/(2cosh^2(c/2)), B_q=(pi/w)^2(R_q cosh(c/q)+q)/(2sinh^2(c/2)); R_q>q and torus-connectedness establish frame positivity and full spectrum interval. For q=2 independent SymPy differentiation reproduces ((2y-1)(4y^4-10y^3+4y^2+y-1))/(4y^2(y-1)^3), with the unique y>1 root by Descartes. Independent Fourier-series Zak summation, 12 parameter sets and 2964 grid inequalities agree. Bounds do not extend by this proof to noninteger q.
